name: Incident Status after assignment
script:
# Check if the ToDo is linked to an Incident document
if doc.reference_doctype == "Incident":
    # Get the Incident document using the reference name
    incident_doc = frappe.get_doc("Incident", doc.reference_name)

    # Check the current status to avoid unnecessary saves
    if incident_doc.status != "In Progress":
        # Update the status field of the Incident
        incident_doc.status = "In Progress"
        
        # Save the updated Incident document
        incident_doc.save()

        # Optional: Log the change for debugging or auditing
        frappe.log_simple(f"Incident {incident_doc.name} status updated to 'In Progress' due to new ToDo assignment.")

name: Incident webform submit
script:
# Event: Before Save
# DocType: Incident
# Script Type: DocType Event

if doc.is_new() and frappe.form_dict.get('web_form'):
    # This is a new incident created via web form
    frappe.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    doc.submit()
    frappe.flags.ignore_permissions = False
